newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates were little changed in lacklustre trade with most traders sidelined due the continued absence of fresh incentives, dealers said on Tuesday.

They said rates were expected to hover around current levels until later in the week as the market is not expected to show any reaction to tonight's release of the BTM-Schroders weekly chain stores sales report, Richmond Fed's May indexes and the weekly Redbook Research weekly retail sales figures.
"The market was quiet and featureless in the morning except for some light activity in short dates," a local dealer said.
"Narrow range trade dominated activity today but some people are waiting for Thursday's retail sales and Friday's producer price index data, for fresh clues to market direction," he said.
In day-to-day rates, Tuesday/Wednesday and Wednesday/Thursday were unchanged from Monday's common 5-5/8 5-1/2 percent, respectively. Week-fixed rose 1/16 percentage point to 5-11/16 5-9/16 percent.

Among longer dates, two-months was unchanged at 5-3/4 5-5/8 percent, four-months unchanged at 5-13/16 5-11/16, six-months unchanged at 5-15/16 5-13/16 and twelve-months unchanged at 6-3/16 6-1/16 percent. - P. Theseira (65-870-3085)
